The '''Chief of State''' was the leader of the [[Mon Calamari Council|Dac Council]]. Candidates for the position were presented by each faction within the Council, which then had a vote to decide who would win. The runners-up in the election became the [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] and [[Defense minister (Dac)|defense minister]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
